newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair, Swissair in HEL-ZUR deal.
newsitem.headline: Finnair, Swissair in HEL-ZUR deal.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said in a statement on Friday it had agreed with Swiss national airline Swissair on a code-share deal on all of their routes between Helsinki and Zurich.
The agreement takes effect on May 4, from which Finnair and Swissair passengers can collect frequent fliers bonus points on each others' flights.
"The deal also covers cooperation in cargo," Finnair said, but did not elaborate.
There are two direct daily flights between Helsinki and Zurich. On four days per week there is a third daily flight. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
